tlabel: Accounts Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Liabilities, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
doc: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

tlabel: Amortization
doc: The aggregate amount of recurring noncash expense charged against earnings in the period to allocate the cost of assets over their estimated remaining economic lives.

tlabel: Assets
doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

tlabel: Assets, Current
doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

tlabel: Cash and Cash Equivalent
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Continuing Operation
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Cost of Product and Service Sold
doc: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

tlabel: Deferred Income Tax Assets, Net
doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

tlabel: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
doc: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Basic
doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Gross Profit
doc: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Trade
doc: Change in recurring obligations of a business that arise from the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services used in the production and sale of goods and services.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

tlabel: Inventory, Net
doc: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Liabilities and Equity
doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

tlabel: Liabilities, Current
doc: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

tlabel: Operating Income (Loss)
doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

tlabel: Other Assets, Current
doc: Amount of current assets classified as other.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
doc: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Payment for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activity
doc: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
doc: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Investments
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
doc: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Short-Term Investments
doc: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
doc: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

tlabel: Research and Development Expense
doc: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both. Excludes write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.

tlabel: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

tlabel: Revenues
doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

tlabel: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
doc: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

tlabel: Short-Term Investments
doc: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

tlabel: Equity, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Benefit Plan
doc: Value of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Value
doc: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer), including liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

tlabel: Additional Paid in Capital
doc: Amount of excess of issue price over par or stated value of stock and from other transaction involving stock or stockholder. Includes, but is not limited to, additional paid-in capital (APIC) for common and preferred stock.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect and Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change and including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
doc: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

tlabel: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
doc: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

tlabel: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
doc: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

tlabel: Common Stock, Value, Issued
doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

tlabel: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

tlabel: General and Administrative Expense
doc: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

tlabel: Income Taxes Paid, Net
doc: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Including Capitalized Interest, Operating and Investing Activities
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, including, but not limited to, capitalized interest and payment to settle zero-coupon bond attributable to accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount; classified as operating and investing activities.

tlabel: Liabilities
doc: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
doc: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
doc: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

tlabel: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

tlabel: Accounts Payable, Trade, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

tlabel: Accretion Expense
doc: Amount recognized for the passage of time, typically for liabilities, that have been discounted to their net present values. Excludes accretion associated with asset retirement obligations.

tlabel: Accrual for Taxes Other than Income Taxes, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for real and property taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Accrued Income Taxes, Current
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all currently due domestic and foreign income tax obligations.

tlabel: Accrued Income Taxes, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all domestic and foreign income tax obligations due beyond one year or the operating cycle, whichever is longer. Alternate captions include income taxes payable, noncurrent.

tlabel: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
doc: Accumulated adjustment, net of tax, that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency from the functional currency of the reporting entity, net of reclassification of realized foreign currency translation gains or losses.

tlabel: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

tlabel: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Decrease for Tax Withholding Obligation
doc: Amount of decrease to equity for grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Other
doc: Amount of other increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC).

tlabel: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, ESPP, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase in additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for employee stock purchase program (ESPP) award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Warrant Issued
doc: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from the issuance of warrants. Includes allocation of proceeds of debt securities issued with detachable stock purchase warrants.

tlabel: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity
doc: Amount of expense (income); loss (gain); increase (decrease) in liability and (increase) decrease in asset used in operating activity; and cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other; in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

tlabel: Amortization of Intangible Assets
doc: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of intangible assets (nonphysical assets not used in production) in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit from such assets.

tlabel: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share, Amount
doc: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) or earnings per unit (EPU) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS or EPU because to do so would increase EPS or EPU amounts or decrease loss per share or unit amounts for the period presented.

tlabel: AOCI, Cash Flow Hedge, Cumulative Gain (Loss), after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) on derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligation, Current
doc: Current portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

tlabel: Asset Retirement Obligations, Noncurrent
doc: Noncurrent portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets
doc: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Current
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

tlabel: Buildings and Improvements, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

tlabel: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Equity Interest
doc: Amount of equity interests of the acquirer, including instruments or interests issued or issuable in consideration for the business combination.

tlabel: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
doc: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

tlabel: Capitalized Computer Software, Net
doc: The carrying amount of capitalized computer software costs net of accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Short-Term Investments
doc: Cash includes currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. It also includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits in that the customer may deposit additional funds at any time and effectively may withdraw funds at any time without prior notice or penalty. Cash equivalents, excluding items classified as marketable securities, include short-term, highly liquid Investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash, and so near their maturity that they present minimal risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months. Short-term investments, exclusive of cash equivalents, generally consist of marketable securities intended to be sold within one year (or the normal operating cycle if longer) and may include trading securities, available-for-sale securities, or held-to-maturity securities (if maturing within one year), as applicable.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

tlabel: Commitments and Contingencies
doc: Represents the caption on the face of the balance sheet to indicate that the entity has entered into (1) purchase or supply arrangements that will require expending a portion of its resources to meet the terms thereof, and (2) is exposed to potential losses or, less frequently, gains, arising from (a) possible claims against a company's resources due to future performance under contract terms, and (b) possible losses or likely gains from uncertainties that will ultimately be resolved when one or more future events that are deemed likely to occur do occur or fail to occur.

tlabel: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
doc: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

tlabel: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
doc: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

tlabel: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
doc: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.

tlabel: Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital
doc: Amount of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock issued.

tlabel: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income (loss) and other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

tlabel: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

tlabel: Construction in Progress Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
doc: Future cash outflow to pay for construction in progress expenditures that have occurred.

tlabel: Construction in Progress, Gross
doc: Amount of structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Liability, Current
doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

tlabel: Contract with Customer, Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Cost of Goods and Service, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization
doc: Cost of product sold and service rendered, excluding depreciation, depletion, and amortization.

tlabel: Cost of Revenue
doc: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

tlabel: Costs and Expenses
doc: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

tlabel: Crypto Asset, Fair Value, Noncurrent
doc: Fair value of crypto asset classified as noncurrent. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

tlabel: Debt, Current
doc: Amount of debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

tlabel: Deferred Costs, Leasing, Net, Noncurrent
doc: This element represents costs incurred by the lessor that are (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. Those activities are: evaluating the prospective lessee's financial condition; evaluating and recording guarantees, collateral, and other security arrangements; negotiating lease terms; preparing and processing lease documents; and closing the transaction. The costs represented by this element are those costs not expected to be recognized in (amortized to) earnings within one year from the date of the statement of financial position or operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Deferred Income Taxes and Other Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and other assets expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Deferred Income Taxes and Tax Credits
doc: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) and income tax credits.

tlabel: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
doc: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

tlabel: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

tlabel: Deferred Revenue, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

tlabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement
doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk related to obligation and assets used to effect settlement.

tlabel: Depreciation
doc: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

tlabel: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
doc: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
doc: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Assets
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from derivative instruments and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities
doc: Sum as of the balance sheet date of the (a) fair values of all liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, and (b) the carrying amounts of the liabilities arising from financial instruments or contracts used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be extinguished or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, net of the effects of master netting arrangements.

tlabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the assets arising from derivative contracts and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
doc: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

tlabel: Dividends, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

tlabel: Dividends Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Dividends, Preferred Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Continuing Operation
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Employee-related Liabilities, Current
doc: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Equity Method Investments
doc: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

tlabel: Finance Lease, Principal Payments
doc: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

tlabel: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
doc: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments
doc: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Goodwill
doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Impairment, Long-Lived Asset, Held-for-Use
doc: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long lived assets held for use (including those held for disposal by means other than sale).

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
doc: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
doc: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the parent. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
doc: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
doc: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
doc: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions
doc: This element represents the undistributed income (or loss) of equity method investments, net of dividends or other distributions received from unconsolidated subsidiaries, certain corporate joint ventures, and certain noncontrolled corporations; such investments are accounted for under the equity method of accounting. This element excludes distributions that constitute a return of investment, which are classified as investing activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable and Other Operating Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables, and operating assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount due for taxes based on the reporting entity's earnings or attributable to the entity's income earning process (business presence) within a given jurisdiction.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities and Other Operating Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in accrued expenses, and obligations classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all taxes owed but not paid, including income, property and other taxes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Asset Retirement Obligations
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of asset retirement obligations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Asset
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Liability
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of expenditures made during the current reporting period for benefits that will be received over a period of years. Deferred charges differ from prepaid expenses in that they usually extend over a long period of time and may or may not be regularly recurring costs of operation.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Employee Related Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Equity Securities, FV-NI
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable, Net of Income Taxes Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Interest Payable, Net
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in interest payable, which represents the amount owed to note holders, bond holders, and other parties for interest earned on loans or credit extended to the reporting entity.

tlabel: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset and (increase) decrease in liability, used in operating activity in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other expenses incurred but not yet paid.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-Based Payment Arrangements
doc: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

tlabel: Indefinite-Lived Trademarks
doc: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

tlabel: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

tlabel: Interest Costs Capitalized
doc: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Operating and Nonoperating
doc: Amount of interest expense classified as operating and nonoperating. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of borrowing accounted for as interest expense.

tlabel: Interest Expense, Nonoperating
doc: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Capitalized, Investing Activity
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest capitalized, classified as investing activity.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

tlabel: Interest Payable, Current
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Inventory, Finished Goods, Net of Reserves
doc: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods held by the company that are readily available for sale.

tlabel: Inventory, Net of Allowances, Customer Advances and Progress Billings
doc: Amount, after deduction of valuation reserves, other allowances, and customer advances received on long-term contracts or programs, of inventory expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle.

tlabel: Inventory, Raw Materials, Net of Reserves
doc: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of unprocessed items to be consumed in the manufacturing or production process.

tlabel: Inventory, Work in Process, Net of Reserves
doc: Carrying amount, net of reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods which are partially completed. This inventory is generally comprised of raw materials, labor and factory overhead costs, which require further materials, labor and overhead to be converted into finished goods, and which generally require the use of estimates to determine percentage complete and pricing.

tlabel: Inventory Write-down
doc: Amount of loss from reductions in inventory due to subsequent measurement adjustments, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration, obsolescence, or changes in price levels.

tlabel: Investment Income, Interest
doc: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investments in and Advance to Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures
doc: Amount of investment in equity method investee and investment in and advance to affiliate.

tlabel: Land
doc: Amount before accumulated depletion of real estate held for productive use, excluding land held for sale.

tlabel: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities
doc: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation
doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities
doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

tlabel: Long-Term Investments
doc: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle).

tlabel: Machinery and Equipment, Gross
doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

tlabel: Margin Deposit Assets
doc: The amount of cash or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivatives securities position which was partially obtained with funds provided by the broker dealer.

tlabel: Marketable Securities
doc: Amount of investment in marketable security.

tlabel: Marketable Securities, Current
doc: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as current.

tlabel: Marketing Expense
doc: Expenditures for planning and executing the conception, pricing, promotion, and distribution of ideas, goods, and services. Costs of public relations and corporate promotions are typically considered to be marketing costs.

tlabel: Equity, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Change in Redemption Value
doc: Change in noncontrolling interest during the period as a result of a change in the redemption value of redeemable noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Continuing Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to continuing operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Continuing Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to continuing operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after income tax of income (loss) including the portion attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest. Excludes the portion attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest recognized as temporary equity.

tlabel: Net Periodic Defined Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Excluding Service Cost Component
doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for net periodic benefit cost components, excluding service cost component, of defined benefit plan. Amount includes, but is not limited to, interest cost, expected (return) loss on plan asset, amortization of prior service cost (credit), amortization of (gain) loss, amortization of transition (asset) obligation, settlement (gain) loss, curtailment (gain) loss and certain termination benefits.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Noncash Financial or Equity Instrument Consideration, Shares Issued
doc: The number of shares issued as [noncash or part noncash] consideration for a business or asset acquired. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired
doc: The value of an asset or business acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

tlabel: Noncash or Part Noncash Divestiture, Amount of Consideration Received
doc: Amount of noncash consideration received for selling an asset or business through a noncash (or part noncash) transaction.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Deconsolidation
doc: The amount of the reduction or elimination during the period of a noncontrolling interest resulting from the parent's loss of control and deconsolidation of the entity in which one or more outside parties had a noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Sale of Parent Equity Interest
doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from sale of a portion of the parent's controlling interest.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Subsidiary Equity Issuance
doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from subsidiary issuance of equity interests to noncontrolling interest holders.

tlabel: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
doc: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

tlabel: Notes and Loans Payable
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Operating Expenses
doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

tlabel: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Adjustments to Income, Discontinued Operations
doc: Amount of noncash income (expense), classified as other, from discontinued operations.

tlabel: Other Assets, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Adjustment for Settlement or Curtailment Gain (Loss), Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

tlabel: OCI, Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), Arising During Period, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Parent
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax
doc: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and before reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Settlement and Curtailment Gain (Loss), after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, before reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
doc: Amount, before reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
doc: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss).

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income, Other, Net of Tax
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in other comprehensive income, after tax, from changes classified as other.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
doc: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
doc: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

tlabel: Other Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount of expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their remaining economic lives, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Expenses
doc: Amount of expense classified as other.

tlabel: Other Liabilities, Current
doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Other Long-Term Investments
doc: Amount of long-term investments classified as other.

tlabel: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
doc: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Income
doc: Amount of income related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Other Item
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other, in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

tlabel: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net
doc: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

tlabel: Other Selling, General and Administrative Expense
doc: Amount of selling, general and administrative expense classified as other.

tlabel: Other Short-Term Investments
doc: Amount of short-term investments classified as other.

tlabel: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability up to amount recognized at acquisition date, including, but not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

tlabel: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs
doc: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

tlabel: Payments of Dividends
doc: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

tlabel: Payments of Financing Costs
doc: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

tlabel: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Investments
doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
doc: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Short-Term Investments
doc: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Investments to be Held in Decommissioning Trust Fund
doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of investments that will be held in a decommissioning trust fund.
